name: tree-authored-identity-kind-resolution
body: `tree_authored_identity` reads the previous worktree database once through `PreviousScan::capture` — the scanned/planned universes, each code FQN's recorded kind and the Agent records — so the tree digest no longer parses `graph.jsonl`; a `None` capture (an absent, unreadable, or pending-state database) contributes empty universes, kinds and agents. Limit: the function opens its own capture rather than consuming the scan's `Prepared.previous`, so a scan that also runs `is_fresh`'s authored reconciliation opens the previous database twice; upgrade by threading the single capture into the tree digest if that second read ever becomes hot.
